nativeLayoutOracle: Copied from src/AgentLang.Llvm/native/runtime_test.c --layout-json; this C-derived layout is independent of the managed ABI declarations.

parameters.name: outputCapacity
parameters.meaning: caller-provided public root slots; must be at least logicalOutputCount and is separate from the workspace capacity

workspaceCapacityQuery.name: agentlang_output_capacity
workspaceCapacityQuery.meaning: historically named query for minimum i64 workspace slots: max(entry output arity, reachable user-word output arity, max declared record field count + 1 helper slots when records exist); an empty record graph still needs one helper slot. This is not the public root capacity.

resultBuffer.logicalOutputCount: number of values the entry body returns
resultBuffer.publicOutputCapacity: caller-provided number of public roots; may equal logicalOutputCount
resultBuffer.requiredWorkspaceCapacity: max(entry output arity, maximum reachable user-word output arity, maximum declared record field count + 1 helper slots when records exist)

preconditions: context is non-null and points to at least 64 bytes aligned to 8 bytes
status is non-null and points to an aligned 4-byte int32_t
raw callers initialize status to INVALID_REQUEST before entry; rejection before context, status, output, and internal workspace/arena spans are validated leaves status unchanged
outputCapacity is at least the logical public output count
publicOutputs is non-null and points to outputCapacity aligned 8-byte int64_t slots when capacity is nonzero
context scratch and retained arena descriptors and their data and node-directory allocations are caller-owned, distinct, and 8-byte aligned
context workspace is non-null and points to workspaceCapacity aligned 8-byte int64_t slots when workspaceCapacity is nonzero
scratch and retained node and byte capacities are representable by uint32_t
the retained arena is empty at entry
agentlang_execute validates the 32-byte ABI prefix before reading any ABI v2 tail field
agentlang_execute validates the full declared spans and pairwise non-overlap before execution

node.retainedScratchFields: mark and forwardHandle are cleared in retained entries

typeIndices.nominalIndices: zero-based contiguous array indexes from 3 onward, sorted by ProgramTypeKey; field_types, node type_id, constructor IDs, and root type IDs all use indexes

typeKinds.nominalDescriptorKind: Int/Bool scalar descriptors use the base kind; record descriptors use record

slot.recordEncoding: signed int64 representation of an arena handle; never infer record-ness from bits

supported: records with supported scalar or record fields
